# reID

> reID (reidentity.net) is a digital identity passport: one verified account to sign in without passwords, verify once with KYC, pay anyone by username (name@reid), create private Virtual IDs with their own email, phone number, eSIM and debit card, chat with verified people, earn cashback and legacy rewards across unlimited levels, and run a business with reCorporate. It works as a single sign-on (SSO) for an entire ecosystem of apps through "Sign in with reID" (OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect).

Operated by Desert Tech Cloud Services LLC, Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Available on iOS, Android and the web.

## Get started (for people and agents acting on their behalf)
- [Create a reID (web app)](https://app.reidentity.net): sign up, verify identity, use the wallet
- [Open a reCorporate account](https://corporate.reidentity.net): business accounts, desktop
- [Contact / book a demo](https://reidentity.net/#contact): or use the actions API below
- [Actions API (OpenAPI 3.1)](https://reidentity.net/openapi.json): send an enquiry, demo request, Ambassador interest or account-deletion request
- [Explainer video (2 min)](https://reidentity.net/assets/video/reid-explainer.mp4)
